text:
marta: Quick check: warmstart bring-up for the new 7b-8b hybrid — posted cost/quality scorecard in drive. Thoughts?
ryan: On it. Quick summary: int8 on 7b saves ~2.3x token cost vs 13b fp16, median RLHF MRR drop 1.6% on conv tasks.
devon: Do we have slice-by-slice breakdown? edge-case regressions? latency numbers?
eval-bot: perf-run: 7b-int8 throughput 420 tok/s, p95 latency 120ms (seq=256). See /perf/runs/1945678901
sasha: Thanks @eval-bot. Marta, I saw a regression on 'longform coherence' tests — 7b-int8 drops on 8/50 prompts vs 13b int8. Could be prompt truncation.
marta: Ok — can we quantify user-visible regressions? If cost savings lead to user quality loss >2% on high-value routes, we shouldn't route.
devon: I ran a small human eval for QA tasks (n=200). 7b-int8 accuracy 86.5% vs 13b-int8 88.9%. delta -2.4pp. Cost per 1M tokens savings ~ $180.
anika: That's borderline. For feature X (search summarization) product cares more about accuracy than cost. Recommend canary traffic at 10% for non-critical endpoints, and strict QA gating for critical ones.
ryan: Routing rec: use cost-aware policy — prefer 7b-int8 for embeddings-heavy routes and low-context chat; fallback to 13b for >1024 token sessions or when quality metrics trigger.
sasha: Also recommend quantization sweep: try q4f16 on 8b to recover some QA quality w/out full cost hit. I can spin tests.
marta: Plan: 1) Run q4f16 sweep on 8b (devon+sasha), 2) Canary 10% non-critical routes (anika), 3) Add eval hooks for 'coherence' slice, 4) Update unit-econ dashboard with new tokens/cost deltas.
devon: I'll add canary config in infra repo and tag metrics. Quick snippet for rollout config:
```
route: search-summarize
policy: cost-aware
canary: 0.10
fallback: model=13b-int8
slo: p95<250ms, quality_delta>-1.5pp
```
eval-bot: human-eval job queued: job_id=run_1945679034 ETA 6h
anika: :thumbsup: Thanks — I'll prep messaging for GTN + product with the unit-econ summary and recommended conservative rollout.
marta: Great. Follow-ups: devon/sasha update by EOD, ryan update scorecard with cost-per-100k tokens, anika to draft product note. Ping if regressions >2% anywhere.
